g.text: An adsorption isotherm couples fluid concentration to equilibrium loading
Hypothetical Langmuir isotherm q_max=2 mol/kg,K=0.5 m³/mol, initially unloaded adsorbent q₀=0. Equilibrium C_e=2 mol/m³,q_e=1 mol/kg:2 mol remain in fluid
and1 mol adsorbs. Isotherm is at fixed temperature; mass-transfer kinetics and adsorption heat are not modeled.
